title: Independent review report v1
description: Signed or unsigned domain-review report for LTG-PR8 / LTG-09. Unsigned slots must keep approval.status=unsigned and approval.signed=false. Approved reports must not claim clinical validation.

findings_summary.description: Free-text findings. Empty string allowed only while unsigned.

limitations_acknowledged.description: Must include that review does not clinically validate the simulator.

checklist_completed.description: True only when protocol checklist was completed for an approved report.

artifacts_reviewed.description: Repo-relative paths reviewed (golden suite, hazard matrix, attack suite, non-claims docs).

status.description: unsigned = reserved slot with no approval; approved requires signed=true and identity fields.

signed.description: Must be false for unsigned slots. Must be true for approved reports.

reviewer_name.description: Empty while unsigned; required non-empty when approved.

reviewer_affiliation.description: Empty while unsigned; required non-empty when approved.

reviewed_at.description: ISO-8601 date or null while unsigned.

signature_ref.description: Path or URI to signature evidence; null while unsigned. Never invent a signature.

attestation.description: Human-readable attestation. Unsigned slots must state that no approval has been given.

conflicts_of_interest_disclosed.description: Required true on approved reports per charter.
